evidence: A model of the vacuum buildout's economy built on stated paths of technology (period_technology.json) and stated inputs (period_inputs.json), each with its basis; the settlements' quantities are their design studies'. The paths beyond their sourced values, the rates of work, the plant masses, the bounds on visits and depot sales and the five open design choices are the study's own. Results hold on those inputs and show what they imply; no plant, market or price is qualified.
units: Years of the programme (zero is 2041); residents; kilograms and tonnes as named; watts and gigawatts; constant dollars of 2041.
reading_rule: Each case is one scenario of demand, one technology case and one schedule of residents. Money is the account with Earth: receipts from Earth's customers against what the settlement pays Earth. Funding needed is the deepest the cumulative account goes; the opening funding is how deep it goes by year 8; the net present values discount each year's net to year zero at the rate named; the payback year is the first after the opening in which the cumulative account is not negative. A solved ramp gives its growth rates by period. at_year holds chosen years in full and every_fifth_year a series of years 0, 5, ..., 220.
